name: Lazarus / Free Pascal
description: A Lazarus or Free Pascal project (.lpi / .lpr / .lpk). The compiler is the judge, not the model.
note: This is a Lazarus / Free Pascal project. Work in small steps that compile: the compiler (fpc, lazbuild) is the judge, not your confidence. State which FPC/Lazarus version and widgetset you assume, because LCL and RTL APIs differ between versions. Change a .pas unit and its .lfm form together so event handlers, declarations and component names stay consistent.
details: A Lazarus or Free Pascal project. The compiler is the judge, not the model: the agent works in small steps that compile, states which FPC and Lazarus version it assumes, and changes a unit together with its form. The Lazarus and Free Pascal tools build the project, list the errors with file and line, and offer Fix with agent; the Standards check reads the whole project.
examples: A form application: build, read the errors, fix, repeat
A console utility in Free Pascal
Move a unit to a newer LCL
Check a project against the four house rules

tools.why: create, build and rebuild Lazarus projects
check and compile plain Free Pascal units
status, diff and commit your work in small steps
